text: Triangle $AMC$ is isosceles with $AM = AC$. Medians $\overline{MV}$ and $\overline{CU}$ are perpendicular to each other, and $MV = CU = 12$. What is the area of $\triangle AMC$?
figure: Tall isosceles triangle AMC with apex A at the top, M at bottom left and C at bottom right, so MC is the horizontal base. U is the midpoint of side AM and V is the midpoint of side AC. Medians MV and CU are drawn and cross at P, which is inside the triangle just above the base. No lengths or right-angle marks are shown in the diagram.
